text:
sam_lee: Heads-up — support case #4532. Customer (tenant: acme-llm) hits 413 when calling /embeddings with mixed-dim batch (128 + 512) and a large total payload. They swear it used to work. Any changes to routing/ingress limits?

jack_support: saw the logs — ingress dropped with 413 from edge proxy: 
```
HTTP/1.1 413 Payload Too Large
X-Edge-Req-ID: e7a2b
```
User payload was ~3.2MB, 40 vectors. They use embed route default model.

miriam.k: we did tweak maximum request body at the gateway for a canary last week (to protect against huge tenant spikes). That was only for the new mesh nodes in eu-west-1 though. Is this customer in EU?

jack_support: yes, eu-west-1. They reported it started ~2026-02-14.

ryan_ops: quick theory: our ingress preflight checks compute an estimated units header (x-embed-units) and fast-fail when estimated bytes > soft limit to avoid work. Did the estimate logic change?

alex_devex: Not intentional. We changed how mixed dims are estimated in PR #1298 — we used conservative rounding up for dim mismatches which increases estimated bytes. Might cause false positives with the soft fast-fail.

sam_lee: Oof. So downstream behavior: if header indicates >softlimit, gateway returns 413? I thought we returned 429 or instruct client to split. Which path is active?

infra-bot: Deploy event: ingress-mesh/eu-west-1 v2.14.3 rolled 2026-02-12 03:12 UTC — includes change: embed-dim-estimator: conservative-rounding enabled.

ryan_ops: Right now flow is: 1) preflight estimate -> if estimate > hard_bytes_limit -> 413; 2) if estimate > soft_units_threshold -> return 413 fast-fail (we opted to use 413 historically for payload rejections to make UX consistent). This was debated.

jack_support: Customer attached example request. curl snippet: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ..." \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"model":"embed-xxl","inputs":[{"text":"...","dim":128},{"text":"...","dim":512}, ...]}'
```
They didn't set x-embed-units header.

miriam.k: We should consider two immediate actions: 1) revert conservative rounding in eu-west canary to unblock this tenant, 2) improve console/SDK guidance so clients can set x-embed-units to avoid surprises.

alex_devex: Agreed on SDK guidance. Also propose server-side: if estimate heuristic changed, log a more descriptive rejection message suggesting split-by-dim or set header, eg "estimated_units=12345; try splitting mixed dims or set x-embed-units". Right now it's opaque.

sam_lee: For short-term I vote revert on canary and patch estimator (we'll keep conservative mode behind flag). For medium-term: change gateway to return 429 with body recommending split instead of 413 — 413 feels like actual HTTP body size violation. 429 signals client-side throttling. Thoughts?

ryan_ops: 429 makes sense semantically, but lots of existing automation checks look for 413 to detect payload issues. Changing status code will ripple to support docs and infra. We can do a transitional body that contains both code and human text explaining.

jack_support: From support POV, clearer text helps more than status. Customers keep pasting logs with only 413; we need recommended next steps (split-by-dim, reduce batch size, set header, or enable multipart/streaming).

miriam.k: UX idea for Console: show per-route "embed estimated units" and a suggested split plan for a sample payload in the route diagnostics panel. Also add a toggle to opt into permissive-ingress (for trusted tenants) to avoid fast-fail.

alex_devex: Implementation note: we already have a shard-suggester service used for router split hints — could reuse it to produce the split plan in console. Might be ~2 weeks to wire up + UI.

sam_lee: OK immediate tasks: 1) rollback conservative estimator on eu-west canary (ryan), 2) change gateway rejection payload to include friendly instructions (ryan + alex to ship), 3) ticket console feature: split-suggester integration (miriam + alex) — queue into next sprint.

ryan_ops: I'll roll back canary now and follow-up with a hotfix to include suggested message text. Will post deploy ts.

infra-bot: Deploy event: ingress-mesh/eu-west-1 v2.14.2 rolled back 2026-02-14 20:03 UTC by ryan_ops.

jack_support: Confirmed with customer — requests accepted again after rollback. They still asked for long-term plan. I forwarded requirements.

miriam.k: For instrumentation: add telemetry label "embed_estimate_mode" and emit whether reject was due to hard-bytes vs soft-units. That will let us chart how many rejects are heuristic vs real.

alex_devex: I'll add a console card mockup in #eng-platform-design and link to this thread. Suggest field: "suggested_action: split-by-dim | set-header | request-dedicated" to normalize UI.

sam_lee: Nice. Closing the immediate incident. Leave this thread open for design/implementation follow-ups. Thanks all :thumbsup:

ryan_ops: Filed: INF-1187 (rollback + friendlier 413 body)

miriam.k: Filed: UX-642 (split-suggester in console)

alex_devex: Filed: DEVEX-320 (SDK doc + x-embed-units examples)

jack_support: Adding note to case #4532 with workaround and timelines.

sam_lee: great. minor follow-up: let's document the rationale for choosing 413 vs 429 in the API contract so downstream clients know what to expect. Put that in Rack: api-contracts/embeddings.md and link it from console.

alex_devex: will do.

sam_lee: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
